bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 189 (Thursday, December 19, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. HAGEMAN:
H.R. 10528.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Atricle I Section VIII
The single subject of this legislation is:
Exempts Federal actions related to energy and mineral
activities on certain Federal lands from the requirements of
the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969.
[Page H7391]

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.
